cves.title: Apache 2.4.49 Path Traversal and RCE
cves.description: A flaw in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allows path traversal and remote code execution on systems where directories outside the document root are not protected by 'Require all denied'.

cves.title: Apache 2.4.50 Path Traversal
cves.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 path traversal and file disclosure vulnerability. The fix for CVE-2021-41773 was insufficient.

cves.title: Apache 2.4.52 DoS via HTTP Request Smuggling
cves.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.52 and earlier are vulnerable to HTTP request smuggling via malformed Content-Length headers.

cves.title: Apache HTTP Server Request Smuggling
cves.description: HTTP request smuggling in Apache HTTP Server mod_proxy via malformed Transfer-Encoding headers.

cves.title: Apache HTTP Server DoS via HTTP/2
cves.description: Denial of service in Apache HTTP Server via HTTP/2 stream cancellation.

cves.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack
cves.description: HTTP/2 rapid reset attack allows denial of service by rapidly creating and canceling streams, overwhelming server resources.
cves.solution: Update Nginx and apply rate limiting configurations

cves.title: Nginx Resolver Vulnerability
cves.description: Off-by-one heap write in the resolver allowing remote code execution when processing DNS responses.

cves.title: Nginx HTTP/2 Memory Leak
cves.description: Memory leak in Nginx HTTP/2 module when handling server push requests.

cves.title: Nginx DNS Resolution Injection
cves.description: Vulnerability in Nginx's DNS resolution that can lead to DNS rebinding attacks.

cves.title: Apache Tomcat HTTP/2 Request Smuggling
cves.description: HTTP/2 request smuggling vulnerability in Apache Tomcat.

cves.title: Apache Tomcat Session Fixation
cves.description: Session fixation vulnerability in Apache Tomcat when using FORM authentication.

cves.title: Tomcat DoS via HTTP/2
cves.description: Denial of service in Tomcat HTTP/2 module via malicious request headers.

cves.title: PHP Phar Deserialization
cves.description: Phar deserialization vulnerability in PHP allows local privilege escalation through crafted PHAR files.

cves.title: PHP CGI Argument Injection
cves.description: PHP CGI argument injection on Windows systems allows remote code execution through crafted requests.

cves.title: PHP XXE Vulnerability
cves.description: XML External Entity injection in PHP's XML parser allows file disclosure and SSRF.

cves.title: PHP Bypass of open_basedir
cves.description: Bypass of open_basedir restrictions in PHP through crafted requests.

cves.title: WordPress Plugin SQL Injection
cves.description: SQL injection vulnerability in WordPress core affecting certain plugin interactions and database queries.
cves.solution: Update WordPress to the latest version

cves.title: WordPress Stored XSS
cves.description: Stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in WordPress allows authenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts.
cves.solution: Update WordPress to version 6.2 or later

cves.title: WordPress Path Traversal
cves.description: Path traversal vulnerability in WordPress block editor allows reading arbitrary files.

cves.title: WordPress REST API DoS
cves.description: Denial of service via WordPress REST API endpoint for password reset.

cves.title: Drupal Arbitrary File Access
cves.description: Arbitrary file access vulnerability in Drupal media library module.

cves.title: Drupal XSS via CKEditor
cves.description: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in Drupal's CKEditor integration.

cves.title: Joomla XSS via Custom Fields
cves.description: Stored XSS in Joomla custom fields module allows attackers to inject JavaScript.

cves.title: Django ReDoS Vulnerability
cves.description: Regular expression denial of service in Django's URLValidator and EmailValidator.

cves.title: Django DoS via File Upload
cves.description: Denial of service vulnerability through excessive memory consumption when handling large file uploads.

cves.title: Django SQL Injection via Trunc
cves.description: SQL injection vulnerability in Django's Trunc and Extract database functions.

cves.title: Django Session Bypass
cves.description: Session verification bypass in Django due to insufficient validation of session tokens.

cves.title: Django File Disclosure
cves.description: File disclosure vulnerability in Django when serving static files with improper path validation.

cves.title: Express.js Open Redirect
cves.description: Open redirect vulnerability in Express.js allows attackers to redirect users to malicious websites.
cves.solution: Update Express.js and validate redirect URLs

cves.title: Express.js XSS via res.locals
cves.description: Cross-site scripting vulnerability when using res.locals with untrusted input in Express.js.
cves.solution: Update Express.js and sanitize all user input

cves.title: Express.js XSS via Response Headers
cves.description: Reflected XSS via crafted response headers in Express.js error handler.

cves.title: Flask Debug Mode Information Disclosure
cves.description: Flask debug mode may expose sensitive information including environment variables and stack traces.

cves.title: Flask Cookie Parsing Vulnerability
cves.description: Improper cookie parsing in Flask could lead to session fixation attacks.

cves.title: Flask Session Cookie Vulnerability
cves.description: Flask session cookies may be vulnerable to tampering when using default secret key configurations.
cves.solution: Use a strong SECRET_KEY and upgrade Flask

cves.title: Laravel RCE via Ignition
cves.description: Remote code execution vulnerability in Laravel Ignition debug page when debug mode is enabled.
cves.solution: Disable debug mode in production, update Laravel

cves.title: Laravel Mass Assignment
cves.description: Mass assignment vulnerability in Laravel Eloquent ORM when using fillable without proper guards.
cves.solution: Update Laravel and review mass assignment configuration

cves.title: Symfony CSRF Token Bypass
cves.description: CSRF token validation bypass in Symfony due to timing attack vulnerability.

cves.title: Symfony Directory Traversal
cves.description: Directory traversal vulnerability in Symfony when serving assets.

cves.title: Ruby on Rails Path Traversal
cves.description: Path traversal vulnerability in Rails ActionDispatch when handling file downloads.

cves.title: Rails SQL Injection via Active Record
cves.description: SQL injection in Rails Active Record when using nested attributes with reject_if proc.

cves.title: Spring Boot Actuator DoS
cves.description: Denial of service via Spring Boot Actuator endpoints when handling large requests.
cves.solution: Update Spring Boot to 3.2.3 or later

cves.title: Spring Boot Open Redirect
cves.description: Open redirect vulnerability in Spring Boot when using forward slash in redirect URLs.
cves.solution: Update Spring Boot to 3.2.2 or later

cves.title: Next.js SSRF Vulnerability
cves.description: Server-side request forgery in Next.js when handling image optimization requests.

cves.title: Next.js XSS via Server Actions
cves.description: Cross-site scripting in Next.js Server Actions when returning unsafe content.

cves.title: Angular Prototype Pollution
cves.description: Prototype pollution vulnerability in Angular core library leading to cross-site scripting.

cves.title: Vue.js XSS via Template Compilation
cves.description: Cross-site scripting in Vue.js when compiling templates with user-controlled content.

cves.title: Nuxt.js Directory Traversal
cves.description: Directory traversal vulnerability in Nuxt.js dev mode allows reading arbitrary files.

cves.title: jQuery XSS via HTML Parsing
cves.description: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in jQuery's HTML parsing method when processing untrusted HTML.

cves.title: jQuery XSS via Cross-Domain Requests
cves.description: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in jQuery when making cross-domain AJAX requests with JSONP.
cves.solution: Update jQuery to version 3.7.2 or later

cves.title: Lodash Prototype Pollution
cves.description: Prototype pollution in Lodash through the zipObjectDeep function.

cves.title: Lodash Regular Expression DoS
cves.description: Regular expression denial of service in Lodash's string manipulation functions.

cves.title: Moment.js Code Injection via String
cves.description: Code injection vulnerability in Moment.js when parsing malicious date strings.
cves.solution: Migrate from Moment.js to modern date libraries

cves.title: Bootstrap XSS via Tooltip/Popover
cves.description: Cross-site scripting in Bootstrap tooltip and popover components via crafted data attributes.

cves.title: IIS HTTP.sys Remote Code Execution
cves.description: Remote code execution vulnerability in IIS HTTP.sys when processing specially crafted HTTP requests.

cves.title: IIS URL Rewrite DoS
cves.description: Denial of service in IIS URL Rewrite module when processing malformed rewrite rules.

cves.title: React XSS via Server Components
cves.description: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in React Server Components when rendering untrusted content.
cves.solution: Update React and sanitize all user-generated content

cves.title: HAProxy HTTP/2 Heap Overflow
cves.description: Heap buffer overflow in HAProxy HTTP/2 multiplexer allows remote code execution.

cves.title: Varnish Cache Poisoning
cves.description: Cache poisoning vulnerability in Varnish via malformed HTTP headers.

cves.title: ASP.NET DoS via Form Body
cves.description: Denial of service in ASP.NET Core when processing large form bodies.

cves.title: ASP.NET Information Disclosure
cves.description: Information disclosure in ASP.NET Identity framework exposing user data.

cves.title: FastAPI Path Validation Bypass
cves.description: Path validation bypass in FastAPI when using regex patterns in path parameters.

cves.title: FastAPI CSRF via Cookie
cves.description: CSRF vulnerability in FastAPI when using cookie-based authentication without proper SameSite attributes.
cves.solution: Upgrade FastAPI and use proper CSRF protection

cves.title: Vue.js Client-Side Path Traversal
cves.description: Client-side path traversal in Vue.js router when handling query parameters.

cves.title: Lodash Prototype Pollution via defaultsDeep
cves.description: Prototype pollution in Lodash defaultsDeep function.
